page: PDF p. 10 (printed p. 8), table 'Campus Financial Facts: Berkeley - Merced Campuses (in thousands of dollars)'
differences_from_original: None in the amounts: both component lines, both sums, the combined total, the page and the IPEDS match agree with the first researcher's record. Additions to the record: the table's heading is 'University endowments', not 'held by The Regents'; the printed 'Annual income distribution' line is now listed (not part of the balance); the PDF has 128 pages, not 129 as the first researcher's notes say.
confidence_note: High that these are the printed figures and that the IPEDS figure equals the foundation total to the thousand. The table itself is unaudited, and the Regents-held lines do not reconcile exactly to the audited endowment note.
note: The table is printed in thousands of dollars; amounts here are multiplied by 1,000 to whole dollars. The table prints component lines only, so every total is the verifier's addition. The table's own heading for the Regents-held lines is 'University endowments' (the audited Note 17, PDF p. 100, describes these as endowments 'held and administered by the University'); it does not use the words 'held by The Regents'. A third line printed under 'University endowments', 'Annual income distribution', is a yearly payout, not a balance, and is left out of the total (the eleven columns sum to 600,614 thousand, which agrees with the audited Note 17 statement that $600.6 million was transferred to the campuses, PDF p. 101). Cross-checks against the audited pages of the same report, all in thousands: the 'Nonspendable endowments' line summed over the ten campuses and Systemwide is 1,316,568, equal to the audited 'Restricted: Nonexpendable: Endowments and gifts' (PDF p. 34) and Table 17.1a (PDF p. 100). The other lines do not tie exactly: University 'Nonspendable' plus 'Other' over all columns is 19,242,993 against audited endowments 6,306,367 plus funds functioning as endowments 14,000,115 = 20,306,482 (difference 1,063,489, not explained in the report); campus foundations' two lines over ten campuses are 13,458,374 against audited Table 17.2a endowments 10,394,411 plus funds functioning as endowments 3,084,513 = 13,478,924 (difference 20,550; the audited figure covers 11 foundations including the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory foundation, PDF p. 40, while the table has ten campus columns, but the report does not say that this is the reason). The audited statements give no endowment figure by campus. The same table, with identical figures, is in the copy filed with the Regents' November 2024 meeting (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/nov24/c2attach2.pdf). This verifier did not open the campus foundations' own audited statements: the UC Davis Foundation and UC Berkeley Foundation sites returned HTTP 403 and The UCLA Foundation's statements were not located.
